questions.prompt: How long is the basic warranty effective?
What will happen if the woman uses an unapproved mechanic?

choiceTexts.B: The warranty is no longer effective.

questions.prompt: What does the woman decide to do?

choiceTexts.A: Take her car to an approved mechanic.

questions.prompt: What is the point of the talk?

choiceTexts.A: Items under warranty must be fixed.
choiceTexts.B: If an item is misused, the warranty may be invalidated.
choiceTexts.C: Machines with unusual wear are difficult to repair.

questions.prompt: Who is the audience for this talk?

choiceTexts.A: Follow the directions on the package.
choiceTexts.B: Return it to the place of purchase.
